about_short_description.short_description: HomeFlow a privately funded, entrepreneurial and fast-growing business.

product.name: Bespoke Websites
product.description: Custom-designed websites tailored to meet the specific needs of estate agencies for online property marketing and client engagement.

product.name: Template Websites
product.description: Pre-designed website templates for estate agencies that facilitate quick deployment and visitor conversion to property valuations.

product.name: Lead Manager
product.description: A centralized system for estate agencies to manage, profile, and automate responses to property-related leads.

product.name: Valuations
product.description: An online tool that provides instant property valuations to generate instruction opportunities for estate agencies.

product.name: Live Chat
product.description: A website feature enabling real-time visitor engagement and lead generation through instant messaging on estate agency websites.

product.name: Google PPC
product.description: Targeted pay-per-click advertising services to help estate agencies improve their visibility and ranking on Google search results.
